subject: Renewal kickoff: capacity stacking, term ladder & QBR availability
messages: Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Subject: Renewal kickoff: capacity stacking, term ladder & QBR availability

Hi Kelly,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — excited to kick off the renewal conversation for Orbit Analytics. Purpose of this thread: align on capacity needs for the next 12 months, discuss a tiered term/price ladder we discussed briefly, and lock a QBR window so we can walk stakeholders through the plan.

High-level proposal (for discussion):
- 90-day staged increase: 1) burst pool for immediate headroom, 2) reserved uplift to smooth throughput for peak models, 3) option to convert burst into reserved capacity at milestone X.
- Term ladder: discounts that scale with committed throughput and a pre-paid reserved band.
- QBR: propose two live windows in May/June to present the plan and get procurement engaged.

Attachments: Orbit_QBR_Slots_Proposed.xlsx (proposed times), I will follow up with a short canary plan and a dedicated offer.

Next steps (please):
1) Confirm primary procurement and legal contacts.
2) Share any hard constraints on start-of-term or billing cycles.
3) Pick 1–2 preferred QBR slots from the attached spreadsheet.

I’ll loop in the pricing and solutions folks once we have slots.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Renewals — Redwood Inference
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity stacking, term ladder & QBR availability

Irene — thanks for the clear summary. Happy to move forward. Quick answers:
- Procurement: procurement@orbit.ai (primary) and James Smith (technical procurement lead) on copy.
- Stakeholders: myself (product), James (procurement/ops), and Lina Park (data platform) — I’ll introduce Lina in a follow-up if needed.
- Constraints: our fiscal quarter closes 2028-06-30, so any billing start before July 1 would need finance approval. Also, we prefer phased invoices tied to milestone acceptance.

For QBR slots, Tuesday 2028-05-30 in the AM or Wednesday 2028-06-06 in the afternoon would work. We’re also very interested in the burst pool + reserve convert option — can you also include a short cost delta estimate for converting burst to reserved capacity mid-term?

I’ll get procurement to drop any required PO templates into this thread.

Thanks,
Kelly Turner
Head of Product — Orbit Analytics
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity stacking, term ladder & QBR availability

Kelly — appreciate the detail. Attaching the dedicated offer (Redwood_Dedicated_Offer_v2.pdf) and a short canary plan below. I kept the numbers high level here; we can surface a line-item workbook once procurement shares PO/terms.

Canary + staging summary:
- Week 0–4: Burst pool (auto-burst to handle traffic spikes, no reserved commitment).
- Week 5–12: Ramp reserved band to target committed throughput (customer telemetry gating).
- Conversion option: if Orbit converts burst to reserved at any time, we prorate based on remaining months and apply a conversion credit.

Proposed QBR times: 2028-05-30 09:00–10:00 PT OR 2028-06-06 14:00–15:00 PT — we’ll block both tentatively.

Immediate next steps (Redwood):
- Pricing workbook and draft SOW (Ben) — by 2028-05-14.
- Procurement checklist & PO template review (Marissa) — pending PO.
- Technical kickoff to align on ingestion/perf (Jordan) — schedule after QBR.

Kelly, if you confirm the 05-30 slot we’ll circulate a calendar invite and the draft SOW. If procurement prefers DocuSign-driven signature flow we can accommodate.

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Offer_v2.pdf

--
Ben Carter
Sr. Deal Lead, Enterprise Renewals — Redwood Inference
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>, procurement@orbit.ai
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity stacking, term ladder & QBR availability

Ben / Irene — confirming the 2028-05-30 09:00–10:00 PT slot for the QBR. Procurement will circulate our PO template by end of week (procurement@orbit.ai). We’ve also asked Lina Park to join the QBR so technical acceptance criteria can be discussed.

On the conversion estimate: procurement asked for a simple delta table (burst -> reserved) for review. Ben, can you please include that with the pricing workbook? If we can get the SOW and the pricing workbook by 2028-05-24 we’ll aim to have procurement comments back before June 15.

Thanks — looking forward to the QBR.
